description: Make suggestion promote atomic: file the issue and remove the pen line in a single on-main commit instead of two independent commits.

userStories.title: Extend writeIssueFile CAS primitive to co-commit extra files
userStories.description: As a maintainer of the on-main backlog writers, I need writeIssueFile to optionally write additional files in the SAME atomic CAS commit as the allocated issue JSON, so a caller can land an issue file plus a companion file rewrite in one commit while the id is still re-derived per CAS attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: WriteIssueFileOptions gains an optional `extraFiles?: FileWrite[]` field; when present, every entry is hashed+indexed into the same temp index as the issue JSON and lands in the same commit-tree commit. [oracle: grep -q 'extraFiles' src/issues/alloc.ts]

Id allocation stays inside the CAS retry loop: allocateId is called on every attempt (a CAS loser re-derives max-id-on-main+1), and extraFiles content is re-indexed on every attempt too. [oracle: bun test test/issues/alloc.test.ts]

A unit test proves that for a call with extraFiles, exactly ONE commit-tree invocation occurs on the successful attempt and the resulting tree contains both the issue file and each extraFiles path. [oracle: bun test test/issues/alloc.test.ts]

An optional commit-message override is supported so a caller can supply a message derived from the freshly-allocated id (e.g. `(id) => "chore(cam): suggestions promote <fp> -> <id>"`); the default message stays `chore(cam): file <id>`. [oracle: grep -q 'commitMessage' src/issues/alloc.ts]
Existing writeIssueFile callers (createLocalIssueOnMain and its tests) are unaffected because both new options are optional. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/issues/alloc.ts (WriteIssueFileOptions ~L42, writeIssueFile ~L139-214), test/issues/alloc.test.ts. Reuse existing helpers already imported in alloc.ts (buildIndexEnv, hashAndIndexFiles, commitAndCasAttempt, CAS_MAX_ATTEMPTS) from src/git/on-main.ts; the extraFiles just extend the `[{path,content}]` list passed to hashAndIndexFiles inside the loop (currently line 194 hashes only the issue file). Keep FileWrite type imported from src/git/on-main.ts. Gotcha (patterns.md L278 'allocateId re-derive-inside-CAS'): allocateId MUST stay the first step of each attempt so a CAS loser gets a distinct id; do NOT hoist it out of the loop. Result shape {id, filename, sha} is unchanged. Do not touch commitTreeToMain (on-main.ts) - the extension lives only in writeIssueFile's own CAS loop.

userStories.title: Make promoteSuggestionOnMain a single atomic on-main commit
userStories.description: As an operator promoting a pen suggestion, I need the filed issue JSON and the suggestions.jsonl pen-line removal to land in ONE on-main commit, so a process death or lost push can never leave the fingerprint in the pen alongside a filed issue (either both land or neither does).
acceptanceCriteria: promoteSuggestionOnMain files the new issue JSON and removes the promoted line from scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl in a SINGLE atomic on-main commit; there is no intermediate main state where the issue exists but the pen line remains. [oracle: bun test test/commands/suggestions.test.ts]

The promote path now bypasses createLocalIssueOnMain and calls the extended writeIssueFile (US-001) directly, passing the rewritten pen content as `extraFiles: [{ path: SUGGESTIONS_JSONL_PATH, content: updatedContent }]` and a commit-message override; the id is re-derived inside writeIssueFile's CAS loop (no pre-computed id/path is threaded in). [oracle: grep -q 'extraFiles' src/commands/suggestions.ts]

PromoteSuggestionOnMainSuccess collapses the two shas (issueSha + penSha) into a single `sha`; the index.ts promote printer (dispatchSuggestions ~L2058) is updated to reference the single sha and still prints the CAM_SUGGESTIONS_PROMOTED sentinel. [oracle: grep -q 'CAM_SUGGESTIONS_PROMOTED' index.ts]

suggestions.test.ts promote assertions are updated: the promote path now asserts exactly ONE commit-tree call (was two: issueSha=firstco / penSha=secondc), and the stale :490 comment stating promote fires commit-tree twice is corrected; all other promote/dismiss tests stay green. [oracle: bun test test/commands/suggestions.test.ts]
The embedded suggestion-fingerprint line and the resolved derivedFrom (from the entry's sourceIssue) are preserved in the filed issue. [oracle: bun test test/commands/suggestions.test.ts]
The dismiss path and buildPromotedDescription (fingerprint-embedding) behavior are unchanged. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/suggestions.ts (promoteSuggestionOnMain ~L473-546, PromoteSuggestionOnMainSuccess type ~L420-433, stale comment ~L490), index.ts (dispatchSuggestions promote branch ~L2051-2063), test/commands/suggestions.test.ts (promote assertions ~L614-660, esp. L630-631 issueSha/penSha). Design: keep promote's own guard (checkMainUpToDate), pen read, entry lookup, prefix + derivedFrom resolution, removeSuggestionLine, and pushMainBestEffort; replace the createLocalIssueOnMain call + the second commitTreeToMain + the post-guard/post-read block (L515-535) with ONE writeIssueFile call carrying extraFiles. Gotcha (spec): createLocalIssueOnMain DROPS the issue filename and cannot co-commit the pen rewrite, so bypass it (promote already does its own guard + derivedFrom resolution + push). Pass derivedFrom, NO specSource (matches current normal-filing behavior that skips fast-track guardrails). The pen rewrite content is id-independent so it is a fixed extraFiles entry (parity with the current two-commit code, which also computes updatedContent once). Do NOT reintroduce a pre-allocated id/path into the commit (patterns.md L278 collision risk).
